Historical defect narratives, commits and prior screenshots are retained. DEF-12 was reproduced and fixed, with its original rejection assertion and genuine-file regressions executed. The original login p95 of 180 ms has no measurement artifact. Login latency was not benchmarked in the new run. DEF-07 is a monitoring observation, not a demonstrated breach of the 200 ms budget. Hash cost and latency should be measured with the actual configured deployment.
GitHub Actions workflows are filtered to main/develop and component paths. Public metadata contains successes and failures; no universal every-push/green-pipeline claim is supported.

The task repaired and retested four concrete defects, completed a real Flutter web → API → PostgreSQL/FastAPI → React → Flutter document workflow, and expanded PostgreSQL security/performance evidence. Final automated suites contain no failures; five cases are explicitly skipped across xUnit/Playwright. The report still contains three unresolved expectation conflicts, 49 historical/unverified cases and two blocked cases. Live Golden Case acceptance, native-device/accessibility validation, member confirmation and CI for the unpushed tested commit remain outstanding; assessment completeness is not claimed.

Retain genuine workflow logs/screenshots and rerun on a native Flutter device where available. Confirm the historical Deed/checklist/Approved flow separately rather than treating the verified Affidavit workflow as identical.

Address the verified Low missing nosniff header finding through the deployment/security policy. Repeat representative PostgreSQL load after staging approval; current two-user read tests do not certify production capacity.

Resolve provider availability/model/budget configuration before further live Golden Cases. Obtain group-member confirmations and explicit push approval before verifying remote CI for the local tested commit; complete accessibility/manual demonstrations.
